name: opencode-mem-plugin
description: OpenCode plugin that captures conversations and hard memories to a centralized opencode-mem-worker

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/opencode-mem.bundle.js --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run bundle
